data.name: DungeonVerse
data.detailed_description:
DungeonVerse transports you to an era after a devastating catastrophe that tore apart space and time and plunged the world into pure chaos. The legendary Staff of Four Pillars transformed reality into a gigantic dungeon and merged it with four unknown universes.

Join Bob on an epic journey through these mysterious worlds. Face deadly dangers, discover forgotten secrets, and find the powerful artefacts that alone can restore balance.

Discover new worlds

Immerse yourself in four completely different universes that emerged after the great catastrophe. Each world tells its own story, marked by hope, betrayal or dark magic. Explore forgotten ruins, mystical forests, alien dimensions and dangerous labyrinths – and discover the secrets they hold.

Defeat the world bosses

At the end of each world, a powerful boss awaits – an embodiment of the events that shaped that reality. Some once stood on the side of good, others embody pure destruction. But all of them stand in your way. Only by defeating them can you secure the artifacts and pave the way to saving the world.

Level Up

Every mystery solved, enemy defeated or chest opened gains you experience and mystical fragments. Use them to level up or buy new items to help you along your journey. Spend your resources wisely, as once spent is gone.

data.short_description: DungeonVerse takes you to four unique worlds that have been reduced to gloomy dungeons by a catastrophe. Explore crumbling ruins, mystical places and forgotten cities, battle powerful bosses and collect all the artefacts to restore balance to your world.
data.supported_languages:
English*, German
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz (Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 compatible (Intel HD 4000 / GeForce GT 710)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 256 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad Core 3.0 GHz+ (Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11/12 (NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 512 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent depictions of melee combat and firearm use. Visual effects include blood spatters during fights and blood stains on environments (walls and floors). Players will encounter scenes of civil unrest, riots, and the aftermath of battles, which include the presence of non-interactable deceased characters (corpses). While the violence is frequent, it is not depicted with extreme gore or detailed mutilation.
